meta.title: Draw down `Wrapper` components and migrate from `styled-components` to SCSS modules
meta.body_summary: Migrate 19 library components from styled-components to SCSS modules, claiming better bundle size, performance, and maintainability.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot migrated 19 components; only maintainer interaction was a lint fix request; closed without merge after ~5 days with zero formal reviews.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At over 30k total changed lines (many from merge commits), this is a large-scale refactor across many components. The close without merge aligns with a high-risk, unreviewed migration that lacked active maintainer engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer rossbulat requested pnpm lint:fix to resolve CI lint errors. No other code or performance review was performed.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved bundle size and performance by eliminating styled-components overhead for 19 components.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed without substantive review; only interaction was lint fix request. No evidence of maintainer approval or interest.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large frontend migration PRs require active maintainer review; without engagement, the PR went stale and was closed despite a successful lint fix.

detection_detail.ci_auto: CI lint failures prompted the maintainer to request pnpm lint:fix; no manual code review or performance validation was observed.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body lists migration patterns and benefits but includes no benchmarks or before/after measurements.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After the lint fix, no further review occurred; the maintainer closed the PR without comment after approximately 5 days.

core_change_summary.description: Migrated 19 components from styled-components to SCSS modules. Added shared _variables.scss with breakpoints, colors, and fonts. Replaced transient props with CSS classes using classNames. Updated imports and removed old Wrapper styled files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most line churn came from merge commits introducing unrelated changes (e.g., package-lock.json, dedot-api refactor); the core migration touched many small files across the library.
change_trajectory: Merged main branch multiple times (bb47be0, cee2c5c, a2a78de).

Maintainer rossbulat commented requesting pnpm lint:fix to resolve CI errors.

PR remained open without further review until rossbulat closed it after ~5 days.
